title: Dan Patch Stables

explain.meaning: A guided horseback ride along trails, mostly at walking pace.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We are in the heat of summer. Please check the weather forecast and temperatures. We will be closing early if temperatures reach over 100 degrees, for the safety of our horses. Trail rides leave hourly by reservation: Monday-Friday 10:00-4:00 Saturday/Sunday 9:00-5:00 Rides are 45 minutes in length.
